decision.question: Which track word for the sections wall?
decision.why: page.js is a plain top-level Page (not a columns host, not a Doc catalog) — `.page > .wide { grid-column: wide }` in core/Page/Page.css reaches the full page-grid width directly, confirmed by layout-check.mjs: empty dropped from 74%/83% to 49.2%/54.1% at 1920/3440 with zero big-empty bands.

decision.question: How to wall 81 questions without new CSS?
decision.why: framework.css already ships `.masonry { columns: var(--column); gap: var(--gap) }` with zero JS, exactly what the brief asked for; no new class needed.
